en: Just as you were about to give up, you found a second, smaller stone tablet.{w}It's pretty shabby compared with the first one.{w}
Your promise to Urna.{w}The Yuan Wine.{w}The wishes of those who lived long, long ago.{w}{p}What can you, who live in the present, do?{w}
Carve Mother Earth's name.
note: Prompt for the name entry (cf. 2657 'carve Urna's name'). 'Mother Earth' as in slice 039 for the same phrase.

en: Touch the stone tablet
Touch the small stone tablet
You left the stone tablet alone.{w}
Elf's Voice

"This land, though it has no name, is a land filled with pure and beautiful hearts."{w}{p}"We, the people of Urna, facing our destruction tomorrow, are reveling in one last feast."{w}{p}"We leave today's words here,{w}to be handed down to the generations to come,{w}and our great Earth Mother's..."{w}
note: Final clause is cut off by the Human's Voice; rendered as a trailing fragment. | Accuracy: 'so that' added a purpose clause absent from the source (a chain of continuative verbs); changed to 'and'.

en: Human's Voice
note: New name box, patterned on glossary 'Elf's Voice'.

en: "Oh?{w}Is that the thing you were talking about the other day, the one that records voices? You finished it!?"{w}
Isfald
"Indeed. At this very moment, I am giving the greeting on everyone's behalf.{w}Ahem. ...O our descendants, who live in the ages to come!{w}My name is Isfal... What is it, Kubet!?"{w}
Kubet
"Whoa, awesome! Elves are sooo awesome!{w}Everybody, come look! Isfald's doing something fun!!"{w}
Domanaya
"Hey, no fair, keeping it all to yourself!{w}I'm the Queen of the Ogres!{w}I'm Domanayaaaa-hoooo!!"{w}
Euratia
"Hiii, this is Euratia.{w}Hey, humans, you haven't gone extinct, have you?{w}Just kiddiiing! I got my voice in there~"{w}
Mundamis
"Say Semnadoc is great!{w}Say 'Semnadoc is great' ten times!!{w}And the next greatest is this here Mundamis..."{w}
"Shut up, all of you!!{w}We've only got so much recording time!{w}It'd be a waste, wouldn't it? Huh!?"{w}
"Then just set out more of 'em!"{w}
note: Kubet suggests setting out more recording devices; Isfald's reply (2689: can only make one or two) settles it.

en: "We're short on Vectraim right now, so we can only make one or two -- how many times do I have to tell you..."{w}
Some Old Geezer
"Hey, Granny, the Elf King's up to somethin'!{w}Looks like fun!"{w}
note: 'The Elf King' = source title for Isfald ([JP]). Glossary keeps Isfald's gender unknown; 'King' is the source word, not inferred from the name.

en: "Now, now, don't get mad. You can just record it again, can't you?"{w}
"It's one take only! It's already getting all of this down, y'know!"{w}
"Don't be so uptight. It'll last till about tomorrow morning, won't it?"{w}
"It won't last anywhere near that long!{w}Look, this is all that's left!!"{w}
"That short!?"{w}
"Now that's a problem!"{w}
"...Elves are useless..."{w}
"You bastaaard!{w}You dare insult the magical research of us elves!?"{w}
Some Baby
"Waaaaaaaaah!!"{w}
Some Mama
"Oh my, oh my, what's wrong, sweetie?{w}Come on, let's go beddy-bye over here. There, there."{w}
"Hey, Granny!{w}Them taters can wait -- hurry, hurry!!"{w}
"Forget it -- can you hear me!?{w}O our descendants, who live in the ages to come! I am..."{w}
"I, Mundamis, am the ooone!{w}The one who took up the great Semnadoc's teachings and whatnot, and set 'em down in books and whatnot!"{w}
note: Source uses the playful listing form (-no, -no); rendered with 'and whatnot'. | Editorial: the shout and the relative clause were split across the {w} ('the one whooo!{w}took up...'), which read as broken; the {w} now ends the shout and the next line restates 'The one who'.

en: "I told you to shut up!!"{w}
"Oh, honestly, what's gotten into this child!?{w}Ooh, there, there. Everyone, I'm so sorr--"{w}
note: Source breaks off mid-word (sumimase); kept cut.

en: "Ohh, honored Four Sages!!{w}Perfect timing -- please shut these people up for me!"{w}
note: Isfald addresses the Four Sages, who arrive and speak one after another; read as plural.

en: "Radrecht heeeeere!!"{w}
Some Old Hag
"Tater-washin' Old Hag heeeeere!!"{w}
'E-Euratia's, like,{w}so pretty, and so nice, and sooo cute, y'know.{w}I'm totally falling head over heels, man~'{w}
note: Source uses the double-bracket quote: Euratia fakes a male voice (Kubet, 2733). Kept single quotes per brief. | Accuracy: removed 'her': Euratia's gender is unknown in the glossary (the source has no object for horechau).

en: "Geez, you... what're you doing, sneaking that in during all the chaos? You even changed your voice..."{w}
"I'm cute too!{w}I'm a pretty young girl with cute muscles! Ooh-hnnngh!!"{w}
"Oh my, so it keeps our voices, does it?{w}La~ la~ la~~ The tentacles dance~~{w}And as they dance, the Elf King~~"{w}
note: Song lines; the last line is an unfinished object ('the Elf King ...'), kept as a fragment. Note sign -> '~'.

en: "My words to posterity...!?{w}Wh-- Lady Shirinmorin, not there!{w}D-don't touch... Hii... Ahh!!"{w}
note: Shirinmorin is female in the glossary, so 'Lady' kept for sama.

en: "Now, you lot, stop getting in the way and..."{w}
"There, there, there...{w}there, there...{w}Ahh, enough already! {11:0001:0002}!!"{w}
note: {11:0001:0002} is a runtime insert, probably a spell name; the next rows show Isfald falling asleep (a sleep spell).

en: "To posterity... pos... zzz... zzz..."{w}
"Oh my, Isfald, Your Majesty!?{w}Do pardon me! Ohohohohoho!!"{w}
note: Isfald-sama: no gendered honorific (glossary gender unknown); 'Your Majesty' used since he is called the Elf King. | Accuracy: Isfald's gender stays unknown (glossary); 'Your Majesty' rests on the title Elf King, not on gender.

en: "And her husband, the Old Geezer, heeeeere!!{w}...Will that do? Is my voice gettin' recorded!?"{w}
note: Editorial: now follows the 'X heeeeere!!' self-intro gag pattern (2727/2729, 064 2825); 'I'm ... heeeeere' mixed two forms.

en: "Mogu wants to say something too, mogu! Um, um..."{w}
note: Raizam refers to themself as 'Mogu' here (Domanaya replies 'Mogu-sama'). No pronouns.

en: "Oh my, my, dear Mogu! What a cute little nose you've got!!"{w}
"Mogeeeee!?"{w}
"I'm amaaazing!{w}I'm greaaat!{w}Himuuuuun!!"{w}
"I-Isfald, Your Majesty! Please wake up!{w}There's no time left!!"{w}
note: Same honorific choice as 2749.

en: "Wha-at... I'm sleepyyy. Me... crunchy bread crusts... Huh!?"{w}
note: Sleep-talk fragment kept fragmentary (childish boku = 'Me').

en: "Ummm, my specialty is bitter melon marinade!{w}I'm surprisingly domestic, y'know~"{w}
"We all made the Yuan Wine together!{w}And Lady Urna said it was delicious!"{w}
"How could this happeeen!{w}There's no time left...{w}Ah... Whoa-whoaaaa~!?"{w}
note: Final cry (ara-aaa~) rendered as a startled 'Whoa'; the script does not show what startles Isfald (Urna speaks next).

en: "Hahaha, you guys are the best!{w}It's fine, forget it. It's our last night -- let's just let loose!"{w}
"Riiight! I love you, Lady Urna~~!"{w}
"B-but!{w}Depending on how things turn out, these could end up being our last words, you know!?"{w}
"You're way too stiff!{w}...Why not just tell them the truth: that we all had fun and were happy, right up to the end?"{w}
"Hey, Lady Urna!{w}If our voices are going in anyway, why don't we sing that one?{w}Let's pass that song on to our descendants!"{w}
"Ooh! Great idea!{w}So... are there any instruments left?{w}Ah, that one, that one! Bring it here~"{w}
"Then I shall take the Healing Tuning Fork."{w}
note: Item name ITEM.CSV 314 (new name).

en: "I'll do the maracas!"{w}
"I'll take the Earthsplit Drum!"{w}
note: Item name ITEM.CSV 312 (Elm3 name). 2795's 'split' joke refers to it. | Accuracy: item name aligned with ITEM.CSV 312 / ITEM_HELP / ITEM_TEXT ('Earthsplit Drum', Elm3).

en: "Hey, Domanaya!{w}You're not supposed to split anything, are you!? Right, Lady Urna?"{w}
"Sorry!{w}Then I'll do maracas too!!{w}I'll shake 'em with all my might! Hnngaaah!!"{w}
"I'll take the Kagura Bells!"{w}
note: Item name ITEM.CSV 309 (new name).

en: "You're ALL on percussion!?"{w}
"Well...{w}we never got the time for you to teach us about instruments..."{w}
note: Deliberate trail-off (no time left before the destruction); kept unfinished. | Editorial: reordered the inverted 'the time for you to teach us... we never...' into English word order; still trails off (Isfald's rebuke 2805).

en: "...Euratia."{w}
